eLayaway, Inc., an online and bricks and mortar merchants, provides layaway services and other payment processing platforms for merchants and consumers. The company has market cap of $10,275. The Company’s technology enables retailers and payment processors with an automated recurring payments administration system to manage layaway, leasing, micro-lending, and layaway-credit hybrid programs, as well as automated clearing house programs. It currently has negative earnings. The firm offers eLayaway, a centralized payment processing solution; eLayawayMALL, a layaway marketplace; PlanItPay.com, an eCommerce merchant; Pay4Tix.com, a member sports and event tickets payment platform; PrePayGetaway.com, a member travel payment platform; NuVidaPaymentPlan.com, a member healthcare payment platform; and eApatado.com, a platform for Hispanic merchants and consumers.
